name: Sreedharan Parokode

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Sreedharan Parokode is a poet and lyricist from Kerala whose writing spans Malayalam and English. His literary work extends from poetry collections to songs for theatre and recordings. Weeping Womb, published by APH in 2009, is recorded in the library catalogue of Sree Sankaracharya University of Sanskrit; his contributor biography in Literary Vibes also identifies collections including Slum Flowers and Mahatma Gandhi.

In “My Poetry”, poems become companions with several roles: they console, play like children, open thought and warn against destructive temptations. Comfort is accompanied by an ethical demand, as poetry urges the speaker to abandon silence when confronted with atrocity. The closing appeal to contentment gives this account of writing an intimate scale, rooted in how a person meets both sorrow and happiness.
